subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw evolve default steer into true pause/abort/resume soft-steer, or narrow this issue to the remaining ordinary-message ingress bug tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003?
rationale: Current main has a partial active/non-streaming fix, but the requested lifecycle changes cross runtime cancellation, transcript/session state, tool execution, and channel fallback behavior, so automation cannot choose the permanent semantics safely.

options.title: Keep As Product Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for the broader soft-steer semantics and land or replace the narrower ingress PR path first.

options.title: Narrow To The Bug Tracker
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 as the canonical remaining work and close this issue only after documenting that true mid-generation pause/resume is out of scope for now.

options.title: Design A New Queue Mode
options.body: Add a distinct opt-in soft-steer mode with explicit abort/resume behavior, tests, docs, and live channel proof before changing defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep As Product Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the broader soft-steer semantics and land or replace the narrower ingress PR path first.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current blamed-line owner for the central steering admission path and authored the recent maintainer replacement work in the same area.
